name: symphony
description: Inspect and administer a configured Symphony installation through its qxctl contracts.
long_description: Connects an MCP host to an explicitly configured Symphony installation through qxctl's machine-readable command registry. Discovers command contracts, executes read-only commands directly, and requires single-use session-bound previews before configured non-read commands.

connection_profile.title: Symphony connection profile
connection_profile.description: Absolute path to an operator-created mode-0600 connection.json file.

prompts.name: symphony-admin
prompts.description: Structured workflow for inspecting or administering a configured Symphony installation.
prompts.text: Inspect symphony_connection first, then use the individually exposed operation tools (or symphony_discover and symphony_describe in live-registry mode) for {{goal}}. Never treat preview as owner authorization or retry unknown non-read outcomes automatically.
